description: Complete Makima AI UI overhaul: ChatGPT-style layout, premium settings panel, proper mobile/desktop responsive design, speaker button refinement, chat history fix, and version bump to 20260528_9
steps: STEP 1 - CSS OVERHAUL (static/css/makima-ai.css): Rewrite the entire makima-ai.css to implement all UI specifications from the request. Key changes: (A) Mobile header - compact with hamburger left, avatar small, title MAKIMA AI, badge ONLINE, settings right. (B) Chat area full width on mobile, max-width 820px centered on desktop. (C) Sidebar as drawer overlay on mobile (from left, dark blur overlay behind), permanent sidebar on desktop. (D) User bubble: right-aligned, dark red bg, red border, rounded 18px, max-width 75%, padding 12px 14px. (E) Assistant bubble: left-aligned with Makima avatar, dark transparent bg, red border, rounded 18px, max-width 78%, padding 14px 16px, line-height 1.55, speaker button bottom-right. (F) Input bar: fixed bottom on mobile (left:0 right:0 padding 10px 12px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), dark glass bg, flex, gap 8px, high z-index), sticky bottom on desktop. Input height 52px, rounded 14px. Send button width 76px, flex-shrink 0, rounded 14px. (G) Speaker button: 32x32, round, right bottom of assistant bubble, dark red transparent bg, red border, glow on hover/active. (H) Settings panel: on mobile - bottom sheet/popover max-height 65vh, scrollable, X button, click-outside-to-close. On desktop - right panel 280-320px. Contains AI MODE (segmented control with dark glass panel, red border, glow, active red glowing, inactive dark transparent, rounded 14px), VOICE, SECURITY sections. (I) Desktop sidebar: avatar + MAKIMA AI top, + NEW CHAT button, scrollable history list, sticky footer with CLEAR ALL and BACK buttons. (J) General style: dark red/black gradient, glass effect, rounded modern, spacing comfortable, font-body for chat text (readable), font-logo for headers. No excessive glow/border/system text.

STEP 2 - JS OVERHAUL (static/js/makima-ai.js): Update the JavaScript to implement: (A) Settings panel as separate overlay/panel instead of dropdown inside voice gear. Mobile: bottom sheet overlay with max-height 65vh, close button, click-outside-close. Desktop: side panel 280-320px on the right. (B) Settings panel sections: AI MODE (segmented control AUTO/GEMINI/GROQ with model selector and SAVE MODEL button), VOICE (voice options + Test Voice button), SECURITY (LOCK button). (C) AI MODE behavior: selecting provider/model does NOT call API. SAVE MODEL only saves to localStorage (makima_ai_provider, makima_ai_model) and shows toast MODEL SAVED. (D) Model options: AUTO shows text 'Gemini first, Groq fallback'. GEMINI shows dropdown with gemini-2.0-flash and gemini-2.5-flash. GROQ shows dropdown with llama-3.1-8b-instant and llama-3.3-70b-versatile. (E) Speaker button states: idle (speaker icon), playing (stop icon), loading (small spinner). Size 32x32. Does NOT call Gemini/Groq - only TTS. (F) Chat history localStorage: ensure keys makima_ai_chats and makima_ai_active_chat_id work correctly. Clicking old chat loads its messages and closes drawer on mobile. Switching chats does not reset other chats. New Chat creates empty chat. Clear All deletes all. Errors saved as assistant messages. Save to localStorage after every change. (G) AI only called on SEND: verify no API calls on page load, refresh, sidebar open, chat switch, new chat, clear all, settings open, model select, save model, back, lock, speaker. SEND checks: empty input rejected, disable during request, 5s cooldown, no auto-retry. Request carries provider+model from localStorage. Debug log: console.log('[MAKIMA] AI REQUEST ONLY FROM SEND', {provider, model}). (H) Version bump to 20260528_9 at top of file.

STEP 3 - HTML UPDATE (templates/index.html): Update all CSS/JS version query strings from v=20260528_7 to v=20260528_9. This applies to: variables.css, base.css, layout.css, components.css, animations.css, drawer.css, responsive.css, makima-ai.css, config.js, ui.js, downloader.js, photo.js, effects.js, main.js, makima-ai.js, analytics.js, ghost-scanner.js, protection.js. Do NOT modify any HTML structure of the downloader section.
acceptance_criteria: makima-ai.css contains complete ChatGPT-style layout with mobile drawer, desktop sidebar, proper bubble styles, settings panel styles, speaker button styles
makima-ai.js implements settings panel as separate overlay (not dropdown), with AI MODE segmented control, VOICE section, SECURITY section
AI is only called from sendMakimaMessage function, nowhere else
SAVE MODEL only writes to localStorage, shows toast, does not call API
Speaker button is 32x32, round, with idle/playing/loading states
Chat history persists in localStorage with correct keys and format
All CSS/JS version strings in index.html are updated to v=20260528_9
No changes to downloader.js, photo.js, or downloader HTML structure
No hardcoded API keys or API key exposure to frontend
No new image assets created or referenced
verification: Run: python -c "import app" to verify Python still loads
Run: grep -c '20260528_9' templates/index.html to verify version bump (should be >= 16 occurrences)
Run: grep -c '20260528_7' templates/index.html to verify no old versions remain (should be 0)
Run: grep 'VERSION 20260528_9' static/js/makima-ai.js to confirm JS version
Run: grep -c 'fetch.*api/ai-chat' static/js/makima-ai.js to confirm API is called only once (in sendMakimaMessage)
Run: grep 'MAKIMA.*AI REQUEST ONLY FROM SEND' static/js/makima-ai.js to confirm debug log exists
findings: All 3 tasks completed successfully. CSS fully rewritten with ChatGPT-style dark theme layout. JS overhauled with settings panel as separate overlay (not dropdown). HTML version bumped from 20260528_7 to 20260528_9 (18 occurrences). Python import check fails due to missing Flask module in environment (pre-existing, not related to changes). Review fixes applied: (1) Escape key handler added in _bindMakimaEvents, (2) model drift fixed by calling _loadProviderSettings on panel open, (3) spinner changed from rotating emoji to opacity-pulsing '...' text, (4) _testVoice guards empty voice list with toast.
